review_target.scientific_scope: Audit whether the ten-slot source record is well formed under its declared inputs and identify the smallest missing assumptions for any physical effective-metric reading.

assumption_register.statement: The carrier, form, signature-scale-continuity tokens, transition record, and certificates are supplied source-extension inputs inside a declared finite scope.
The source metric-form record is not assumed to be a target Lorentzian metric or an operational spacetime metric.
Transition data state a source-side transport obligation and do not establish target covariance.
Missing, ambiguous, or target-dependent slots fail closed to a bottom value or a precise obstruction label.
The assembled object is a draft/control source record, not an adopted source law or physical metric.
No matter coupling, action, field equation, detector protocol, proper-time interpretation, or benchmark result is supplied.
The construction is confined to the declared beta-separated marked finite-graph context.
Review should distinguish well-formed source-record assembly from positive physical provenance.

scientific_material.content:
\begin{definition}[Declared Source Package]
A declared source package for this packet is a tuple
\[
E_{\mathrm{decl}} =
(\Gbeta,\MetricDataCand(E;\Gbeta),\SigScaleCont(E),\MetricFormAssign(E),
\Tsrc(E),\rho_E),
\]
where \(\rho_E\) is a receipt that the package is used only inside the declared
source-extension scope. If any required component is absent, ambiguous outside
the declared source scope, or dependent on target metric, atlas, proper-time,
detector, or benchmark semantics, the package evaluates to \(\BottomSrc\).
\end{definition}

\begin{lemma}[Source-Record Assembly]
If \(D_E\), \(Q_E\), \(S_E\), \(\Theta_E\), \(N_E\), \(B_E\), \(F_E\),
\(C_E\), \(O_E\), and \(L_E\) are all supplied by the accepted scoped evidence
stack and declared source-side transition data, then
\(\geffCand(E;\Gbeta,\Tsrc(E))\) is a well-formed draft/control source-side
record.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Source-Transition Audit Obligation]
The tuple \((Q_E,S_E,\Theta_E)\) states only a source-side transport obligation
under declared transitions. It is not a proof of target covariance, not an
adoption of \(\MetricFormAssign\) or \(\SigScaleCont\) as source law, and not a
field-equation statement.
\end{lemma}

\begin{proposition}[Candidate Constructor Result]
Under the accepted scoped evidence stack and declared source-side transition
data inspected in this packet, the previous obstruction
\[
\OBGEFF\mbox{-}\mathrm{SOURCE\mbox{-}METRIC\mbox{-}FORM\mbox{-}UNDERDETERMINED}
\]
is narrowed: a draft/control source-side candidate record
\(\geffCand(E;\Gbeta,\Tsrc(E))\) can be assembled as above. The result is
\emph{constructed\_candidate\_pending\_audit}.
\end{proposition}

claim_boundary.statement: Separate the narrow claim that a typed source record can be assembled from the stronger claim that a physical effective metric has been derived.
Identify the smallest missing assumptions for uniqueness, naturality, dynamics, operational meaning, robustness, or physical interpretation.
Do not infer adoption, matter coupling, field equations, benchmark recovery, or any protected scientific conclusion.
